routes.label: Estimate the quotient and check the choice

question: The population of the United States in \(1980\) was \(226{,}504{,}825.\) The area of the country is \(3{,}615{,}122\) square miles. There are \((5280)^2\) square feet in one square mile. Which number below best approximates the average number of square feet per person?
solution:
Convert the total area to square feet, then divide by the number of people. The desired quantity is
\[
T=\frac{3{,}615{,}122\cdot5280^2}{226{,}504{,}825}
\]
square feet per person. Using convenient nearby values gives
\[
T\approx\frac{3{,}600{,}000\cdot28{,}000{,}000}{225{,}000{,}000}
=448{,}000.
\]
This suggests \(500{,}000\).

We can confirm the choice without finding a more precise quotient. The midpoint between \(100{,}000\) and \(500{,}000\) is \(300{,}000\). Rounding the numerator downward and the positive denominator upward gives the strict lower bound
\[
T>\frac{3{,}000{,}000\cdot5000^2}{250{,}000{,}000}
=300{,}000.
\]
Thus \(T\) is closer to \(500{,}000\) than to \(100{,}000\). Every other choice is smaller than \(100{,}000\), so it is farther away still. The best approximation is \(500{,}000\) square feet per person, choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
